adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `RestAdapter.basePath` was changed to check `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1` (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6), and `ADMIN_MODELS` now includes `'embeddable-host'`. At the same time, the new admin UI creates records via `this.store.createRecord('embeddable-host')` (admin-embedding controller), while the API/serializers embed ids using underscored keys like `embeddable_host_ids` (EmbeddingSerializer with `embed: :ids`), which could lead to both dashed and underscored type strings flowing through the client. The review comment is therefore a legitimate architecture/normalization concern grounded in this change (the adapter is now compensating for type-name inconsistency), but it is not a clearly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone since the store’s internal type normalization behavior isn’t shown.
